jobs.occupation: Senior Process Engineer – Bioprocess & Equipment (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Biotechnologie)
jobs.description:
Who are weAs a biotechnology company, at Insempra we don’t simply hope for a better future – we actively work to create one.For far too long, companies have relied on chemical production processes, depleting our planet’s limited resources in the process. That’s why our mission is to create a world built on naturally high-quality products and to help restore the balance between people and our planet.
On our journey towards a better future, we are currently supported by a team of more than 40 dedicated people bringing together scientific, entrepreneurial and visionary expertise. But one important person is still missing: you!
We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer – Bioprocess & Equipment (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible at our site on the IZB Campus in Munich/Martinsried.
We offer:
• A central technical role in building out a new production platform from the ground up
• Direct influence on process and equipment design decisions
• Close collaboration with an experienced, interdisciplinary team of around 12 people
• Room to grow the role toward team leadership as the group scales
• A dynamic, science-driven environment in the Munich biotech ecosystem
• You’ll become part of a dynamic start-up creating real value for both the environment and society.
• You’ll take on a responsible role with plenty of room to shape and develop your area.
• You’ll work in an international team with an open feedback culture, flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes.
• 30 days of annual leave (based on full-time employment).
• Flexible working hours.
• Fresh fruit and vegetables as well as free drinks.
• Regular team events.

For this position you will perform the following duties:
• Design and maintain P&IDs for process and downstream equipment
• Specify, select and procure process equipment; manage vendor quotations and technical evaluations
• Plan and oversee equipment installation, commissioning and qualification
• Act as the primary technical contact for external partners - equipment vendors and engineering firms
• Translate process development results into scalable, robust and safe production processes
• Collaborate closely with strain engineering, downstream processing, manufacturing and QA/regulatory teams
• Support HSE and ATEX-relevant risk assessments for process and equipment design
• Contribute to technical documentation, SOPs and process descriptions for internal use and external partners
• Support process development for new and existing microbial production processes, applying a working knowledge of fermentation to prepare processes for implementation
• Contribute to process control strategy for batch and fed-batch processes

Your profile:
• Degree in bioprocess engineering, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a related field
• 10+ years of hands-on experience in bioprocess development and scale-up
• Proven experience creating P&IDs and specifying process equipment
• Track record of equipment procurement, installation and commissioning in a lab, pilot or production environment
• Confident interfacing with external engineering firms and equipment suppliers
• Structured, hands-on and solution-oriented working style, comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment
• Working knowledge of fermentation process control, automation and instrumentation
• Fluent English; German is a plus
• Willingness to work on-site in Planegg

General Data Location: Munich/Martinsried (IZB Campus), approx. 30 minutes from Munich Central Station
Working hours: Full-time
Start date: 01.12.2026

jobs.occupation: Strategy & Operations Lead (f/m/d) (Unternehmensberater/in)
jobs.description:
Short DescriptionSPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce, and recognized with the SPARK AI Innovation Award and a place among LinkedIn's Top Startups in DACH.

Role
In this role, you sit inside the Founders' Office and work on the decisions that set SPREAD's direction. You own the strategy cycle and translate it into company goals and OKRs; you drive the strategic and improvement initiatives that come out of it, and you run the operating rhythm that keeps the leadership team deciding and the company executing. Alongside that, you own SPREAD's ecosystem of partners and senior industry advisors. You shape how the whole company hears about strategy through the monthly Assembly, and you build the material founders and the leadership team decide on. You report to the VP Strategy & Finance and work daily with the founders, the leadership team, and the people delivering the outcomes you help define.
Your Mission
• Own the strategy cycle from analysis through to a written strategy the leadership team commits to, then translate it into company OKRs, goals, and the quarterly review rhythm that keeps every team measured against them.
• Drive strategic and improvement initiatives end to end. Recent examples include improving our cross-functional delivery model, leveling up our performance management system, building out our competitor intelligence, and rolling AI agents out company-wide.
• Run the operating rhythm of the leadership team across the weekly leadership meeting, monthly workshops, and half-year offsites. Set the agenda, prepare the discussions and decisions, and track every decision and task.
• Own the monthly company Assembly, from storyline to deck, so every team leaves knowing where SPREAD stands, where we are going, and what it means for their work.
• Build and steer SPREAD's partner ecosystem across hyperscalers, systems integrators, strategy consultancies, and tech companies, and convert those relationships into commercial opportunities, co-marketing and integrated offerings.
• Manage SPREAD's portfolio of senior industry advisors, former executives from the automotive and defense industry, to generate commercial opportunities and capture deep industry insights and expertise.
• Step into selected high-stakes commercial opportunities and ongoing engagements alongside Sales, Product, Value Realization, and Engineering, bringing structure and pace.
• Prepare investor materials and board reporting across fundraising rounds and quarterly cycles.

Your Experience
• 4+ years in strategy consulting, investment banking, or an operating strategy role inside a scale-up, with end-to-end ownership of your own workstreams and direct exposure to the client side.
• Deep understanding of the automotive and/or defense industry. You know how a vehicle or a defense platform moves from requirement to development to integration to testing to production to field service, and you can hold that conversation with a senior engineering leader.
• Business-fluent German and English, because both appear in the same week across leadership meetings, partner negotiations, customer conversations, and investor material.
• A strong analytical toolkit covering quantitative analysis and executive-level materials. You do the analysis, and you write the slide that makes it decision-ready.
• Track record of driving decisions with executive stakeholders, including the judgment to know which questions belong in the room and which you resolve before the meeting starts.
• Experience turning strategy into action, whether through OKRs, a goal cascade, or an operating rhythm you designed and ran yourself.
• Commercial instinct for partnerships and customer opportunities. You are comfortable opening a relationship, holding a cadence, and being honest with yourself about which relationships produce outcomes and which absorb time.
• AI-native working style. You use AI tools daily to scale your output across research, analysis, drafting, and workflow automation. SPREAD is an AI-first company, and every team member operates accordingly.
• Based in Berlin or close enough for regular in-office collaboration.

Why SPREAD?
• Work on the questions that decide where a company building engineering intelligence for the products that move the world goes next, with the founders and the leadership team as your direct counterparts.
• Own initiatives end to end with full visibility across Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and the partner ecosystem, and see your work land in the company's direction and in decisions that actually get made.
• Grow inside a high-talent-density environment with direct feedback and a leadership team that expects you to challenge it.
• Attractive compensation, an annual learning budget, and workation options.
• Deutschlandticket mobility budget and Urban Sports Club partnership.
• 30 vacation days and one paid volunteering day per year.
• Lunch provided three times per week in our Berlin office.

jobs.occupation: Senior Enterprise Account Executive (f/m/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Short DescriptionSPREAD builds AI-powered software that helps leading manufacturers like B MW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Bosch, and Rheinmetall master the complexity of software-defined products.

Our Engineering Intelligence Platform transforms disconnected technical data into usable insights that enable engineering teams to bring products to market up to 10× faster , 50% more cost-efficiently , and with higher quality. Recognized with the SPARK AI Innovation Award (Handelsblatt & McKinsey, 2024) and listed among LinkedIn’s Top Startups DACH , SPREAD is one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies.

The Senior Enterprise Account Executive role at SPREAD fits someone who thrives on complexity and momentum and enjoys working with senior and C-level stakeholders. You are curious, ambitious, and commercially sharp, with a consultative mindset and a passion for value-based selling. You like clear goals, transparent numbers, and working in a team that moves quickly, values precision, and plays to win.
Your Mission
• Own and drive the full enterprise sales cycle from targeted outbound and first meetings through to closing and handover.
• Build and execute structured account plans for strategic customers, including stakeholder maps, key initiatives, and growth paths.
• Run value-based, multi-stakeholder deal cycles that connect customer pain points with SPREAD’s software solutions.
• Develop and deepen relationships with senior decision-makers (up to C-level) and act as a trusted advisor for your accounts.
• Identify, shape, and realize up- and cross-sell opportunities to expand existing accounts and increase customer lifetime value.
• Prepare and deliver focused demos, workshops, and presentations tailored to technical and commercial audiences.
• Lead commercial and contract negotiations independently and secure sustainable, mutually beneficial agreements in the enterprise segment.
• Maintain a healthy, well-qualified pipeline with disciplined forecasting and documentation, while sharing customer insights with internal teams.

Your Experience
• 5+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience for SaaS, software solutions, or software development/engineering services , with full-cycle ownership from prospecting to closing.
• Proven track record in value-based, consultative sales , translating customer pains into solution concepts, and quantifying business impact.
• Experience selling into complex industrial or mechatronic environments such as automotive, aerospace, defense, heavy machinery, rolling stock, or similar.
• Evidence of successfully closing multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with long cycles and significant contract values (six-figure ARR or comparable project sizes).
• Strong outbound track record: you systematically build your own pipeline , multi-thread accounts, and are comfortable with cold outreach to new logos.
• Consistent quota attainment over several years and stable tenures in previous roles, demonstrating resilience and long-term customer development.
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills in German and English , including confidence in working with senior leadership and C-level stakeholders.
• Structured, analytical way of working that lets you prioritize complex opportunities, manage multiple deals in parallel, and naturally use CRM systems to keep your pipeline clean and forecastable.

Why SPREAD?SPREAD is transforming how engineering organizations work with data and AI. Our customers, from BMW to Rheinmetall, rely on our platform to deliver complex products faster, more cost-effectively, and with greater precision.
We have grown double digits every year since 2019, and we are only getting started. You will join a company that combines the scale and credibility of an established enterprise partner with the energy and opportunity of a modern AI scale-up.

At SPREAD, you will have:
• Real Enterprise Impact: Sell a category-leading Engineering Intelligence Platform that creates measurable business value and multi-million-euro savings for complex manufacturers entering the data and AI era.
• Value-Based Software Sales Environment: Work in deal cycles where your focus is on quantifying impact, shaping solution value, and building long-term partnerships instead of pushing features or competing on discounts.
• Growth and Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership for strategic accounts, new industries, and regions in a company that is expanding fast and where your results directly shape our go-to-market and future roadmap.
• Strong Overall Package: Attractive OTE with uncapped commission, company car, Urban Sports partnership, 30 vacation days, workation options, a volunteering day, and an annual learning budget.
• Security and Flexibility: Work with a product that meets enterprise requirements from day one, with ISO 27001 and TISAX certifications, GDPR-compliant deployments in cloud or on-prem, and a hybrid work model that fits your life.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer in Production [Mid-Senior; F/M/D] (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:

And that’s creating massive challenges for health, climate, and
animal welfare. At Project Eaden, we’re tackling this head-on with
our patented fiber spinning technology: plant-based meat with
authentic texture and taste. Our LEKKA products are already in
millions of homes across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Your
mission If you're a mechanical engineer and want to apply your skills

innovative mechanical systems for plant-based meat manufacturing, this
is your chance to take the next step and take operational
responsibility. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing,
purpose-driven startup. Key responsibilities Machinery Installation &
Commissioning: Support installation of new food processing equipment,
perform commissioning and validation procedures, and conduct
functional testing to ensure proper operation before production use.
Continuous Modification & Improvement: Analyze existing processes and
equipment performance, identify improvements, and design modifications
to increase efficiency, reliability, and food safety compliance.
Implement optimizations in the production environment. Equipment
Repair & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical,
integrated and pneumatic equipment failures. Troubleshoot complex
issues in mixers, conveyors, industrial machines, and automation
equipment. Implement timely repairs to minimize production downtime.
Mechanical Design & Process Optimization: Build and test mechanical
prototypes and operational processes, validate design performance
through testing and prototyping, iterate designs based on production
feedback and food safety requirements. Cross-functional Collaboration:

equipment performance and resolve complex production challenges.

planning and leadership. Technical documentation: Develop and maintain
comprehensive technical documentation including S.O.P.s, schematics,
mechanical drawings, process diagrams, and system specifications.
Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage relationships with external
vendors, contractors, and service providers. Coordinate procurement
activities, oversee contractor performance, and ensure project
deliverables meet specifications. Your profile In this role, you'll be
responsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developing
mechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, and
supporting the mechanical engineering needs of our production
operations. As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work on
everything from equipment design to production support. Requirements
Professional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineering
experience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably with
exposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automated
systems. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical
Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or
related technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance,
reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge of
food industry applications preferred. Technical Skills: Knowledge of
manufacturing processes and production optimization techniques,
familiarity with lean manufacturing principles. Strong troubleshooting
abilities with hands-on experience developing mechanical solutions and
diagnosing and repairing mechanical equipment failures. Proficiency
with CAD software, process modeling tools, and manufacturing software
systems. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving
abilities with experience in root cause analysis and process
troubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and develop
longlasting cost effective engineering solutions. Operational Agility:
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt
quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Language
Proficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional level
in the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

inflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scaling
operations. Be part of something transformative and build it from the
ground up. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and
angels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time is

irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away

and alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. We
welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age,

next few years, we aim to evolve into a more distributed workplace,
blending the flexibility of remote work with the strength of our
shared values and connection.

Ramp-up and Integration Lead (f/m/d)

- Operations Center Neuenburg 2
- 80% - 100%
- Supply Chain Management
- Englisch

As the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4’000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.

Our new logistics system is complex, ambitious, and, let's be honest, not going to commission itself. That's where you come in. As our Ramp-up and Integration Lead, you're the central link between engineering, project management, and operations. Your mission: troubleshoot, track risks, and make sure our ramp-up stays smooth and on schedule.

Deine Aufgaben

- Management and tracking of commissioning and testing phases
- Coordination of all technical activities between TGW, Engineering, and Operations
- Tracking of defects, open items, and risks (including prioritization)
- Ensuring rapid problem resolution through structured escalation
- Active management of and transparency on technical risks, progress, and system status
- Close alignment with the Industrial Systems Lead and Maintenance Setup

Deine Fähigkeiten

- A technical degree or qualification in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or Maintenance or equivalent hands-on experience with a Master Craftsman certification
- Strong knowledge in automation and controls, with hands-on troubleshooting skills and the ability to quickly build and share a deep understanding of complex technical systems
- Language skills: C1 English and C1 German
- Strong stakeholder management and ability to align multiple technical parties under time pressure
- Familiarity with commissioning and acceptance testing environments in automated facilities
- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectiveness
- Maintaining resilience and agility while adjusting strategies as needed

Warum startest du bei uns?

- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach
- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas
- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes
- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload
- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € or 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut
- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefits

Diversity is our culture.

To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.
